basis: Synthetic positive arithmetic inputs only; no measured sediment data or design limits. Equations: USACE HEC-RAS 2D Sediment Technical Reference Manual v6.4.1 (2023), section 2.14.1 equation 132 and section 2.13.1 bed shear velocity definition after equation 111; public locator in critical_sediment_motion docstring.
hand_calculation: Reference submerged unit weight: (2250-1000)*10 = 12500 N/m^3. Grain stress scale: 12500*0.004 = 50 Pa. Critical stress: 0.05*50 = 2.5 Pa. Friction velocity: sqrt(2.5/1000) = 0.05 m/s. Multiplying diameter by 4, density contrast by 9, gravity by 0.25 or Shields parameter by 4 multiplies stress by that factor and velocity by its square root. Multiplying water density by 4 at fixed density contrast preserves stress and halves velocity. All factors are synthetic choices for hand arithmetic.
